consent_text: We use Google Analytics to understand how this site is used. No ads. You can decline.
privacy_description: How Suiteframe handles quote requests and Google Analytics on suiteframe.ch.
privacy_intro: This page explains how suiteframe.ch handles quote requests and analytics. We do not run ads and we do not sell personal data.
privacy_analytics_body: If you accept, we use Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC) to measure page views, language choice, scroll depth, which sections and gallery images are seen, and clicks on contact actions. Events contain no names, emails, or message content. IP addresses are truncated by Google Analytics.
privacy_consent_body: Analytics storage is denied by default (Google Consent Mode v2). A non-blocking bar lets you accept or decline. Your choice is stored in this browser (localStorage key sf_consent). You can change it any time via Cookie settings in the footer. Until you accept, we do not store analytics cookies.
privacy_retention_body: Event-level data in Google Analytics is retained for 2 months. Aggregated reports may persist longer in the Google Analytics property.
privacy_impressum_body: Legal name and postal address will be published here once available. Until then, contact customer@suiteframe.ch.
form_note: We use this to prepare a quote. No newsletter, no ads.
form_success_body: Thank you. We will get back to you shortly.
form_error_send: Could not send. Please email customer@suiteframe.ch.
privacy_form_body: If you submit the quote form, we receive your name, email, phone, property address, and listing or website link by email at customer@suiteframe.ch via Web3Forms (form delivery processor). We use these details only to prepare and send a quote and related correspondence. We do not sell this data.
